label: Bible Study
prompt: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his _____:
verse: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
note: Christ left an example — and believers walk in his footprints.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast _____ all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
verse: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
note: David's charge to young Solomon: be strong, fear not — God won't fail you until the Temple work is finished.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and _____ his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verse: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
note: Balaam saddled his donkey and set out for Moab — about to be out-prophesied by the animal he was riding.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good _____, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king's household.
verse: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king's household.
note: Four lepers found the Syrian camp abandoned and realized keeping the good news to themselves was wrong.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of _____.
verse: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
note: 'Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness' — then Psalm 29 thunders the phrase 'the voice of the LORD' seven times.
